title: Cap how many revisions each post keeps

keep.description: Revisions to keep per post. WordPress keeps every revision by default.

description: Limits how many revisions WordPress keeps for each post from now on. Nothing is deleted: WordPress prunes the oldest revisions of a post the next time that post is saved, so a post nobody edits again keeps everything it already had.
breaks: Older revisions of a post disappear the next time that post is saved, so a change from long ago can no longer be restored
